label: GOLDEN-VEXRISCV-LIVE-JTAG-UART
title: Current golden VexRiscv direct JTAG-UART interaction control
triggered_by: User confirmed the current Flash image is the known-good a10-linux-riscv VexRiscv design and that direct nios2-terminal access is sufficient

authorization.user_statement: 目前Flash中存储的是成功启动的vexriscv（a10-linux-riscv），可以添加一个任务，看如何用当前的设备进行串口交互。直接使用这个命令行即可读取和交互。
authorization.scope: Attach directly to the currently running golden VexRiscv JTAG-UART, observe the live console, and perform one bounded read-only shell interaction when a prompt is available.
excluded: stopping PID 5640 or any unknown/pre-existing process

acceptance: The exact direct nios2-terminal command connects to device 1 instance 0; the transcript identifies the running golden VexRiscv/Linux console; after a recognizable shell prompt, a unique echo marker is transmitted and observed together with a subsequent prompt. Record command, timestamps, exit path, transcript hash, process ownership and final resource state.
failure_policy: Do not program, reset or power-cycle to obtain a prompt. Preserve the direct-session transcript and classify whether failure is enumeration, target output, prompt availability or host-to-target interaction. Stop only the task-owned terminal if a bounded observation timeout expires.
resource: Every GamePC/JTAG action acquires gamepc. Run at most one foreground task-owned nios2-terminal at a time; bounded retries are allowed only after read-only enumeration. Return 75 means wait. Preserve standard server PID 5640.

result.target_output: PASS; VexRiscv Linux output observed from kernel command line through PLIC initialization

result.final_state: golden remains running; JTAG UART #0 visible; PID 5640 preserved; no residual terminal; gamepc FREE
